entities.name: Right SI region pain pattern
observations: Osteopathic sacral landmark asymmetry with right-positive seated flexion localizes dysfunction to the right sacral/sacroiliac region; groin referral favors SI-complex ligament involvement over lumbar or hip pathology.
Among listed structures, posterior sacroiliac ligament is the best-fit ligament choice, although findings do not uniquely identify an individual ligament.
